data.animaCaption: Crouching beside the lantern-lit goldfish pool in her cream wisteria yukata, she lifts a clear water bag holding a bright red goldfish toward you with sparkling eyes. Warm orange lantern light ripples across the water surface and lights her smiling face from below.
data.promptProse: Framed low just above the shimmering wooden basin of a summer festival goldfish stall, Ayachi Nene crouches in a cream yukata adorned with trailing purple wisteria blossoms and a soft pink sheer obi sash. Holding up a clear water-filled plastic bag with a tiny crimson goldfish darting inside, she beams brightly at the viewer while droplets still sparkle on her fingertips from the torn paper scoop. Rows of paper festival lanterns glow warm amber behind her, sending dancing golden caustic reflections upward across her chin, kimono sleeves, and the dark rippling water.
data.story: 捞金鱼的纸网刚破了一角，那尾小红金鱼就险险滑进了碗里。宁宁蹲在水池边把装好水的透明小袋子高高举到灯笼光下，眼睛亮得比远处烟火还耀眼——「捞到了！你看它游得多快，我们一起给它取个名字吧？」
